Maya: Quick pre-handoff FYI — seeing higher-than-usual customer embed jobs against pool-a in us-west. Not an incident, but want to flag before I leave. Current pool-util ~82% over the last 10m, burst usage creeping toward threshold.

oncall-bot: INFO: pool-a burst usage 78% (threshold 75%) — no outage. Run `/pool-status --short` for snapshot.

Tony: thanks. can you paste the /pool-status output? also did we schedule the nightly corp-analytics job at 23:00 or did that move?

Maya: pasted output below — corp-analytics is still scheduled for 23:00 (unchanged), but I reduced concurrency on the job a bit.

```
POOL   REGION  UTIL  BURST_USED  RUNNING_JOBS
pool-a us-west 82%   78%         42
pool-b us-west 40%   10%         9
```

Maya: Actions taken: reduced corp-analytics concurrency from 12 -> 8 (should drop tail), enabled prefix caching for hot keys for that job, and paused a low-priority internal sweep that was queuing up. Leaving these notes in the runbook.

Eli: I can take coverage for the next couple hours (18:30-21:00). If this climbs >90% sustained for 5m, call for escalation. Recommend prep: 1) be ready to bump pool-a burst +1 (quota allows it), 2) route corp-analytics to pool-b as fallback.

Jen: FYI — unrelated but FYI: eu-ephemeral quota for acct-c is at 95%. Not touching current US pools but filing here in case multi-region jobs get rerouted.

Tony: approved the fallback routing if needed. @Eli, if you do the swap, ping me before and after. Quick command to simulate: `route set corp-analytics pool-b --dry-run` then apply.

Maya: Handing off to Eli at 18:30 PST. TL;DR: pool-a ~80% trending flat, corp-analytics concurrency reduced, runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pool-capacity. No immediate outage, just watch headroom.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF: Maya -> Eli (coverage 18:30-21:00) recorded at 1836234567.

Eli: Taking it over. I'll post a 19:00 status update and escalate if we hit >90% for 5m. Will run the dry-run then decide.

Tony: Thanks — appreciate the notes. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks all, leaving my phone on for 20m if anything spikes.

Eli: 19:00 check-in: pool-a steady at 79%, corp-analytics tail reduced. No action needed yet. (last update)
